Public project goal: 本地文档项目
公开目标：保留真实文件与历史来源。
Branch direction: 
Requested change: 生成确定性本地文件
Create a new asset without replacing another slot. Write a UTF-8 Markdown document, at most 65536 bytes. Read only the explicit inputs at .imd/reads/artifacts/<as>. No website or IPFS publishing.
Produce exactly the declared named output. Do not delete or claim to have read unselected assets. No paid child jobs, autonomous spending, contract deployment or token launches.

Public project goal: 本地文档项目
公开目标：保留真实文件与历史来源。
Branch direction: 
Requested change: 更新本地文档
Restore the selected target from .imd/reads/artifacts/<as>; that authenticated file is the update baseline, even if the workspace is newer. Preserve existing content except the requested changes. Write a UTF-8 Markdown document, at most 65536 bytes. Read only the explicit inputs at .imd/reads/artifacts/<as>. No website or IPFS publishing.
Produce exactly the declared named output. Do not delete or claim to have read unselected assets. No paid child jobs, autonomous spending, contract deployment or token launches.

Public project goal: 本地网站项目
公开目标：保留真实文件与历史来源。
Branch direction: 
Requested change: R1 初始页面
Create a new asset without replacing another slot. Write self-contained UTF-8 HTML. The named accepted HTML must be the exact dist/index.html bytes. dist must contain only index.html, no symlinks. Inline all CSS and JS. Inline selected images byte-for-byte as PNG/JPEG/WebP data URIs; do not transcode or fetch remote resources. Each image at most 262144 bytes, images total at most 524288 bytes, final HTML including Base64 overhead at most 2097152 bytes. Retain old markers on updates. No website or IPFS publishing.
Produce exactly the declared named output. Do not delete or claim to have read unselected assets. No paid child jobs, autonomous spending, contract deployment or token launches.
